tests.name: T01: draft hydration must adopt the revision of the body it actually loaded before the first save

A01: structured tool results must keep a usable artifact reference even if their preview cannot shrink
A02: accepted user message with legal raw length must remain readable beyond encoded body limit
A03: artifact rename failure must remove the temporary file it created
Q01a: Stop during default-model lookup must prevent the next native turn from starting
Q01b: Stop during launch resolution must not be mistaken for permission to auto-resume after exit
Q02: resume in default selection must resolve and restore native default
Q02: resume in default selection must refuse when native default cannot be determined
Q03: previews of many pending requests must remain within aggregate snapshot budget
Q04: saving a valid 262144 byte draft must preserve its original
Q04: saving a valid 133120 byte draft must preserve its original
Q04ui: an irrecoverably truncated legacy draft must report damage and not silently save an empty draft
Q05: expanded todo payload must refresh when the item revision advances
F01a: three native requests must share the overall snapshot budget
F01b: a valid near-limit draft plus timeline must keep snapshot bounded
F01c: Chinese request body range must respect byte rather than UTF16 length
F02: a user Stop while waiting for unusable run exit must prevent queued auto-send
F03: restoring Codex native default must replace the sticky explicit model
F04: accepted input receipt must survive subsequent selection changes
F05: SDK active_goal must outrank a later compatibility text acknowledgement
F08: reviewer capability must guard native review command as well as ordinary submit
F01d: event page must respect its 256 KiB byte limit
F01e: live durable notification must keep the stored event byte limit
F06a: previewed long user message must expose a route to its original text
F06b: previewed plan must expose full content before copying or downloading
F07a: newer first snapshot must still restore saved draft if old initialization is discarded
F07b: attachments edited before equal-watermark initialization must survive
F06c: plan copy must include the complete original plan rather than its preview
RC01: canceling application quit must not close running Agents
RC02a: Stop during launch resolution must prevent subsequent dispatch
RC02b: an orphan goal turn after Stop must be interrupted as well
RC03: unknown steer receipt must never be automatically resent as a new turn
RC04: a 36 KB input below the 256 KiB text contract must arrive intact
RC05: user questions and elicitation must produce their own answer shapes
RC06: approval UI must not offer decisions missing from availableDecisions
RC07: changing Claude model inside the same task must change actual SDK model
RC08: starting in ask must allow a confirmed later full tier via close and resume
RC09: nested Claude assistant output must not be persisted as the parent answer
RC10: Claude native goal clear must clear the displayed goal
RC11: close must wait for actual ChildProcess exit before dropping run ownership
RC12: unavailable goal capability must be refused rather than invoked
RC13: a queued project image must be rechecked before a host read after a symlink change
RC14: launch errors must remain visible in the snapshot-backed timeline
RC18: SDK failure before a start signal must release the task dispatch latch
RC19: native usage limits must project a limited / paused state, not ordinary failure
RC15: text typed while awaiting a durable send receipt must survive that receipt

RC17: numeric request shortcut must select first, and wait for Enter to confirm
N07: initial stale snapshot must not overwrite a newer snapshot or new draft
N05b: a task with an explicit model must still offer the default choice
N10: native command must not discard ready attachments without delivery or explanation
N01: retrying an accepted input must not replace its frozen image contents
N02: failed open must retain an owner whose close has not observed exit
N03: completion before the start receipt resolves must still drain the next queued input

N06a: an approval must not execute a full plan while its snapshot displays a truncated shell

N08: Claude max_output_tokens must retain its specific limited reason
